LLM #3+ — Agent.chat(goal)
System (built once in __init__, reused each call):
① _system_prompt (base):
"You are an expert coding agent..."
Working directory: {cwd}
Project type: Python / Node.js / Go / Rust
Top-level structure: src/, tests/, ...
Repo outline (≤500 chars):
file.py: 5: def func(), 12: class Cls
Git status / branch
② + longterm.system_addendum:
~/.agent/memory/*.md contents
③ + context.system_addendum:
Compressed history summary (if triggered)
Messages: [{role: user, content: goal}, ...]
Tools: TOOL_SCHEMAS (read_file, bash, grep_files, ...)
